title: Agent action event
description: One action the agent took, streamed to the browser. Law travels ONLY in server-rendered statute_ref; prose asserting law is dropped. The model cannot supply a citation. FROZEN - changing this breaks every team.

anyOf.description: A checklist item id that exists in the loaded city file. REQUIRED for point_to, highlight, mark_item and draft_field. OPTIONAL (omitted or null) for add_note only, which may be a general note with no item.

text.description: draft_field and add_note only. Shown as an accept/reject suggestion.

statute_ref.description: SERVER-RENDERED. Present only when the model passed a statute_id that resolved against a statutes.json entry with confirmed:true. Every field is copied from that entry; none is ever taken from model output. This is the ONLY channel through which law reaches the UI.
